# IDSRegistryService
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/securitize/IDSRegistryService.sol)

**Title:**
IDSRegistryService

Minimal interface for the Securitize DS Protocol registry service.

The registry maps wallets to KYC'd investor IDs. A `DSToken` transfer only succeeds if both
the sender and receiver wallets are registered here (plus compliance rules). An integrating
contract (e.g. an Ark) must therefore itself be a registered wallet before it can hold or
move the token; registration is performed off-chain by Securitize (issuer/exchange role).


## Functions
### isWallet

Whether `_address` is a registered investor wallet.


```solidity
function isWallet(address _address) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_address`|`address`|The wallet to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|true if the wallet is registered|


### getInvestor

Returns the investor ID that `_address` belongs to (empty string if unregistered).


```solidity
function getInvestor(address _address) external view returns (string memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_address`|`address`|The wallet to look up|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`string`|The investor ID string|
